question: Should OpenClaw accept authBootstrap: "harness" plus Codex harness-owned auth routing as the permanent boundary for fresh macOS Codex onboarding?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive plugin SDK and auth-provider routing contract; source review can verify the implementation, but automation cannot decide whether this is the intended long-term seam.

options.title: Accept harness-owned Codex auth
options.body: Land the PR after maintainer review and exact-head refresh, treating the new SDK flag as the documented seam for trusted native runtime harnesses.

options.title: Move the fix back into core auth
options.body: Ask for a redesign that preserves core-owned OpenAI auth bootstrap and repairs Codex setup without a new harness auth contract.

options.title: Pause for broader setup design
options.body: Keep the PR open until macOS onboarding and provider-routing ownership are settled across Codex and sibling runtimes.

recommendation.title: Accept harness-owned Codex auth
recommendation.body: Land the PR after maintainer review and exact-head refresh, treating the new SDK flag as the documented seam for trusted native runtime harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee and strongest current history owner for the Codex harness and macOS onboarding paths affected by this decision.
